principles: Layer 3 proof must be sequentially gated by fresh Layer 1 and Layer 2 proof.
Loop Engineering may authorize only the loop-engineering claim boundary.
Host verdicts are review evidence, not Authority or production proof.
Every unlock must fail closed on stale, missing, mismatched, or local-only evidence.
drivers: The Layer 3 document requires a formal evaluator/proof path before running UDM baselines.
The user wants all work completed, but only real correctness issues fixed.
Existing Layer 2 formal proof code should be reused where logically equivalent to avoid arbitrary new framework surface.

options.name: A: Extend the existing formal baseline evaluator with a bounded loop-engineering branch
pros: Keeps one command surface for formal capability evaluation.
Reuses existing suite rebuild and fail-closed patterns.
Minimizes behavioral expansion to the documented Layer 3 boundary.
cons: Requires careful target dispatch so Layer 2 behavior does not regress.
Requires explicit tests to prove Production/global remain locked.

options.name: B: Add a separate Layer 3-only command
pros: Reduces chance of accidentally changing Layer 2 evaluator behavior.
cons: Adds a new CLI surface when the current command already represents formal claim evaluation.
Raises risk that different claim evaluators drift over time.

chosen: A: Extend the existing formal baseline evaluator with a bounded loop-engineering branch
rationale: Choose the existing formal evaluator command because the user is asking to unlock a new layer of the same capability claim system, not create a new product surface. The implementation should add only the missing loop-engineering proof path and keep higher-layer claims locked.

preMortem.scenario: Layer 3 unlock accidentally authorizes Production Safety or global Capability Claim.
preMortem.trigger: Evaluator treats loop-engineering suite PASS as full capability proof.
preMortem.mitigation: Add explicit claim-boundary tests requiring productionSafetyClaim and globalCapabilityClaim to remain LOCKED.

preMortem.scenario: Layer 3 consumes stale Layer 1 or Layer 2 proof after code changes.
preMortem.trigger: Proof root from an older HEAD/materialHash is reused.
preMortem.consequence: loopEngineeringClaim unlocks against the wrong target.
preMortem.mitigation: Require lower-layer suite reports to bind the same headHash/materialHash and fail closed on mismatch.

preMortem.scenario: UDM expected-block baselines are converted into PASS to make the suite green.
preMortem.trigger: Suite aggregator counts every successful gate block as normal PASS.
preMortem.consequence: No-false-DONE and block/escalate guarantees become meaningless.
preMortem.mitigation: Validate outcome against baseline expectedOutcome and require refusal/gate/stop evidence for EXPECTED_BLOCK.

preMortem.scenario: Claude/Codex host artifacts are mistaken for Authority receipts.
preMortem.trigger: Review evidence names look authoritative in final reports.
preMortem.mitigation: Keep host verdict refs separate from receipt refs and assert authority.productionDone/fullAuthorityDone remain false.
